remarks: Step into unparalleled luxury in this exceptional residence, recently renovated with a sophistication worthy of Architectural Digest. Originally built in 1991 and now reimagined for modern living, this extraordinary home blends timeless elegance with contemporary comfort. A grand entryway sets the tone, while a new slate roof and exquisitely landscaped grounds enhance its refined curb appeal. Inside, every room is thoughtfully designed, with a vibrant color palette that creates unique and delightful experiences throughout. The heart of the home is the custom chef's kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and bespoke finishes. The luxurious primary suite offers a serene, spa-like retreat with every amenity imaginable. Guests and family alike will be delighted by the one-of-a-kind playroom, crafted to inspire creativity and joy. Perfectly sited on a quiet cul-de-sac within the former Woolworth Estate on the Upper West Side, this one-of-a-kind property offers 4 spacious bedrooms, 4 full baths, and 2 half baths. With an extensively renovated pool area and meticulous updates throughout, every detail of this home has been designed for both beauty and function-creating an extraordinary living experience unlike any other. This is more than a home-it's a lifestyle.
